page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.t5-c1m4.large is a burstable instance type designed for entry-level workloads with variable CPU utilization. Powered by an Intel Xeon 8163 processor running at 2.5 GHz, this x86_64 server provides 2 vCPUs mapped to a single physical core with hyper-threading enabled. It features 8.0 GB of system memory, translating to 4.0 GB per core, and does not include local storage or dedicated GPU hardware. Virtualization is managed via the KVM hypervisor.

Performance benchmarks position this instance in the lower tiers. The stress-ng single-core CPU performance score of 1057.79 is classified as weak, while the multi-core score of 2090.03 falls into the poor category. Memory bandwidth tests show 150.43 GB/sec for cached small blocks and 16.3 GB/sec for uncached large blocks, indicating constrained throughput under heavy memory operations. Similarly, the Geekbench single-core and multi-core scores of 870.0 and 1493.0 reflect limited computational capacity.

Due to its burstable CPU allocation and baseline network bandwidth of 0 Gbps, this instance is highly cost-efficient for workloads that remain idle or run at low baseline utilization with occasional spikes. It is not suitable for sustained high-performance computing, large-scale databases, or memory-intensive applications. Appropriate workloads include low-traffic web serving, development and testing environments, lightweight microservices, and basic background task processing.
